description: What is on the caller's autario account and in the app store: apps, connectors (Google Ads, Meta Ads, Shopify, GA4 and more) with their health, charts, saved app views, and data edits waiting for review.

action.description: Which operation to run. overview = every app, connector and dataset on your account (sign-in); connectors = your connected platforms (sign-in); connector_status = freshness and report health of one connector (sign-in), needs connector_id; apps = apps in the autario app store; app_context = one app's data map and KPI catalogue, needs app_id; app_artifact = one saved app view, needs app_id, slug; app_preview_url = preview link of your own app (sign-in), needs app_id; charts = published charts; chart = one chart with its data and insight, needs chart_id; overlays = accepted edits on one of your datasets (sign-in), needs dataset_id; proposals = edits waiting for your review (sign-in), needs dataset_id.

app_id.description: app_context: App id from my_workspace action "apps", e.g. "audience-360", "company-compare", "projects", "builder". app_artifact: App id from my_workspace action "apps", e.g. "audience-360", "projects", "builder". app_preview_url: Id of an app you own, as returned by apps action "create". An app you do not own answers not found.

chart_id.description: The chart ID (numeric) or slug (hash like "nMGf-iAO") to retrieve

connector_id.description: The id of the connector instance (from my_workspace action "connectors").

format.description: Output wire format for this MCP call. Default 'toon' (Token-Oriented Notation, fewest tokens, best for tabular rows). 'compact' = minified JSON. 'json' = pretty JSON for readability. The REST API always returns JSON regardless.

limit.description: charts: Maximum number of charts to return (default 20, max 100) overlays, proposals: Max entries (default 500)

offset.description: Number of charts to skip for pagination

q.description: Search term to filter charts by title or question

slug.description: Artifact slug from my_workspace action "app_context" / my_workspace action "overview" (your_artifacts[].slug).

name: my_workspace
